Head pulling off the line of delivery, slicing the ball aerially
Locked front leg stopping fluid hips rotational release
drills: Rotational medicine ball launch drill into boundary nets
Full toss power striking drill clearing cow corner boundary
Front-foot clearing step drill on agility markers

stance.label: 1. Stance
stance.cue: Wide athletic power base, ready to clear front leg and launch
techniquePoints: Balanced foundation aligned for overhead stroke

backlift.label: 2. Backlift
backlift.cue: High violent backlift cocked high above rear shoulder
techniquePoints: Top hand controls backlift height on overhead plane
Stationary head tracking bowler release point

stride.label: 3. Stride
stride.cue: Wide aggressive stride clearing front leg to open up hips

downswing.label: 4. Downswing
downswing.cue: Massive upward swing arc accelerating violently to leg side
techniquePoints: Weight committed through the line of the stroke

impact.label: 5. Impact
impact.cue: Heavy brutal impact launching ball high toward mid-wicket boundary
techniquePoints: Head position: Stationed over front knee

follow_through.label: 6. Follow-through
follow_through.cue: Full follow-through with torso rotating 360° through the ball
techniquePoints: Arms extended through the finish at -115°

recovery.label: 7. Recovery
recovery.cue: Controlled step back to neutral ready stance
techniquePoints: Controlled recoil pushing off the lead foot
Hips and weight re-centering toward crease line

Switch Hit.name: Switch Hit
commonMistakes: Delayed foot transition leaving batter locked in no-man stance
Loss of balance during the handedness pivot before ball arrives
Over-swinging with non-dominant arm losing control of blade
drills: Mirror stance transition agility drill switching feet on delivery stride
Non-dominant arm tee striking drill building muscle memory
Switch-hit balance hold progression checking head alignment

stance.label: 1. Stance
stance.cue: STANCE REVERSES: Batter pivots completely to opposite handedness
techniquePoints: Balanced foundation aligned for angled_off stroke

backlift.label: 2. Backlift
backlift.cue: Mirrored high backlift prepared in new dominant stance
techniquePoints: Top hand controls backlift height on angled_off plane
Stationary head tracking bowler release point

stride.label: 3. Stride
stride.cue: Front foot strides aggressively into the off-side line in new orientation

downswing.label: 4. Downswing
downswing.cue: Fluid swing accelerating through the line with switched dominance
techniquePoints: Weight committed through the line of the stroke

impact.label: 5. Impact
impact.cue: Clean strike through covers in mirrored orientation
techniquePoints: Head position: Stationed over front knee

follow_through.label: 6. Follow-through
follow_through.cue: High glorious mirrored follow-through holding textbook balance
techniquePoints: Arms extended through the finish at 75°

recovery.label: 7. Recovery
recovery.cue: Pivot smoothly back into original orthodox batting stance
techniquePoints: Controlled recoil pushing off the lead foot
Hips and weight re-centering toward crease line

Scoop Shot.name: Scoop Shot
commonMistakes: Getting head trapped in line of ball, risking serious facial injury
Not crouching low enough to get underneath the yorker trajectory
Blade face too vertical causing ball to deflect down into wickets
drills: Foam ball scoop ramp drill deflecting ball over wicketkeeper net
Deep crouch squat stability drill holding low foundation
Underneath bat-face angle check using slow reaction feeds

Hips and weight re-centering toward crease line

Ramp Shot.name: Ramp Shot
commonMistakes: Attempting to hit too hard instead of using the bowler pace
Not stepping inside the line, getting cramped by the rising delivery
Blade angle too flat hitting ball straight back into the turf
drills: Short-pitch pace ramp drill guiding balls over fine leg/keeper netting
Inside-out footwork step drill clearing line of off stump
Blade face angle calibration drill on reaction bowling feeds

Helicopter Shot.name: Helicopter Shot
commonMistakes: Failure to dig out yorker on toes resulting in clean-bowled dismissal
Premature wrist snap losing leverage through the ball
Torso falling forward off balance onto the pitch
drills: Toe-crushing yorker dig-out drill with weighted rubber ball
Full 360-degree overhead bat rotation wrist mobility drill
Wide stance stability balance drill with resistance band
